title: Jagged Crispy Malaysian Tempeh Satay
description: A cultured and romantic Malaysian dish featuring crispy tempeh satay, this recipe is perfect for a quick and delicious meal. It is made with fast action yeast and air-fried to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, curry powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the tempeh skewers to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the tempeh from the marinade and cook in the air fryer for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together fast action yeast and 1 tablespoon of water.
Brush the yeast mixture onto the tempeh skewers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Serve the crispy tempeh satay with the onion and garlic mixture.
